sources.title: Proxmox VE8 Administration Guide / Firewall
facts_used: Per-VM IN/OUT rules and ipfilter-netN/MAC filtering support vNIC boundary enforcement.
Legacy host FORWARD/VNet rules are not supported by pve-firewall.
The8.x guide describes the newer nft backend as technology preview and requiring guest restart when changing backend.

sources.title: Proxmox VE8 QEMU Guest Agent
facts_used: Guest agent exchanges information/commands over a host-to-guest channel; retain console fallback.

sources.title: OpenWrt Static routes
facts_used: Static route configuration selects target, gateway and logical interface; actual OW policies remain uninspected.

sources.title: Linux kernel bridge documentation
facts_used: Bridge forwards Ethernet frames; bridge netfilter can observe/filter bridged packets.

sources.title: Debian13 interfaces(5)
facts_used: Manual address-family configuration does not assign a static address by itself; actual IPv6 state must be checked.

source_inference_separation: Topology/sequence/ACL/rollback are proposed engineering design, not proof of deployment. PVE runtime facts come from whitelisted local SSH evidence.
